intro: 2 plans, one per drawing (Level 1 / Level 2), in millimetres, exported from Revit
5,877 + 21,379 drawing items, on 30 and 27 layers in use
Level 2 lined up on Level 1 by 10 grid labels within 0.0 mm, with no shift
39 doors, 7 windows and 3 passages found by the openings detector
173 furniture boxes in 13 kinds, one per piece
layers: A-WALL, A-WALL-PATT (cut fills, outlines, paired lines)
A-GLAZ-CURT, A-GLAZ-CWMG (curtain wall); glass wall types on the wall layers (by their type name)
A-DOOR, A-DOOR-FRAM, A-DOOR-GLAZ, A-DOOR-HDLN (head heights from the door names)
I-FURN, L-PLNT, P-SANR-FIXT, Q-CASE, Q-CASE-HDLN, Q-SPCQ (one coloured box per piece, its height set per kind)

0, A-DETL, A-DETL-GENF, A-FLOR, A-GENM, Defpoints, E-COMM, E-ELEC-FIXT, A-ANNO-DIMS, A-ANNO-DIMS-100, A-ANNO-NOTE, G-ANNO-NPLT, G-ANNO-TEXT, G-ANNO-TTLB (and the grid, used only to line the levels up)

captions.read: 5,877 drawing items on Level 1 and 21,379 on Level 2, read from 2 drawings in millimetres.
captions.sort: Walls are on A-WALL, A-WALL-PATT: 1,789 lines. Glass on A-GLAZ-CURT, A-GLAZ-CWMG. Door symbols on 4 door layers. Stairs and railings on their own layers. The 23 other layers (furniture, fittings, grid, labels and the like) build no walls: the 173 furniture pieces among them become one coloured box each, the rest is left out.
captions.align: The 10 grid labels sit at the same coordinates in both drawings (within 0.0 mm), so Level 2 goes straight onto Level 1, with no shift, and rises to {L2level} m (Level 1 at {L1level} m).
captions.pair: The wall layers give 737 wall pieces (737 line pairings) and the glass layers 121 glass pieces.
captions.merge: The pieces merge into 31 wall runs and 7 columns. Each of the 39 doors is cut out of its wall, the 7 windows get panes and the 3 passages stay as they are.
captions.raise: Walls rise to {L1height} m on Level 1 and {L2height} m on Level 2; 33 lintels over the doors and windows; railings and the parapet 1.10 m.
captions.finish: Floor plates (open over the stairs and the lift shaft), stairs and room names go in, and last the furniture: 173 coloured boxes, one per piece, 13 kinds. Done: 2 levels, 31 wall runs, 33 lintels, 36 glass pieces, 13 rooms named, 29 rooms closed, 2 stairs you can climb.
